title: Support and cosupport conditions
statement:
Let $X$ be a
separated scheme of finite
type over a field $k$, and work in the bounded constructible
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-coefficient categories of
[def-weil-pbc-qbar-category] on the etale site of $X$, with the
constructible conventions of
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and the cohomology sheaves
$\mathcal H^i$ of [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For
$K\in D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ write

$$
\operatorname{SuppCon}(K)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-i}(K)\le i\qquad(i\in\mathbf Z),
$$

with the convention that the empty support has dimension $-\infty$, and

$$
\operatorname{CosuppCon}(K)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\operatorname{SuppCon}\bigl(D_XK\bigr),
$$

where $D_X$ is the Verdier dual of [def-trf-dualizing-complex].

lean.note: §1(B): the previous PbcSupportCondition accepts the earlier PBC pair category, and exposes only the support half there. The consumer uses the currently recorded intrinsic common-stage category of Frobenius pairs. This module publicly retains that prior interface and supplies both support and cosupport on the intrinsic category. Supports are closures of nonzero completed geometric cohomology fibres after rationalization; cosupport is support of the actual ambient RHom into a representing dualizing object. The natural exceptional-adjunction property determines that object up to compatible isomorphism, so it is universally quantified without arbitrary data choices. The compact-support construction is generalized to arbitrary base fields with invertible l, retaining the source generality; no site/coefficient universe equality is imposed.
